description: Top-level index for declarative policy metadata consumed by governance checks, audit reports, and future runtime diagnostics. It must not change runtime behavior by itself.

files.purpose: Permitted and conditional reflective scope metadata
Prohibited request, out-of-scope, and source-trust metadata

runtime_contract.fallback: If a policy metadata file is unavailable, runtime behavior must remain unchanged. Governance checks should fail in CI, but request-time safety must continue to rely on existing detectors, classifiers, guards, and eval-backed constants.
